parameters.name: Content
parameters.description: The Base64-encoded content of the error page. The content type is specified by the Content-Type field.

parameters.name: ContentType
parameters.description:
The Content-Type field in the HTTP header. Valid values:

*   text/html
*   application/json

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the custom error page.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the custom error page, which can be obtained by calling the [ListPages](~~2850223~~) operation.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the custom error page.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-page --id 50000001 --name example --description a_custom_deny_page --content-type text/html --content PGh0bWw+aGVsbG8gcGFnZTwvaHRtbD4= --site-ids 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa UpdatePage --region cn-hangzhou --SiteIds '[1]' --Description a_custom_deny_page --ContentType 'text/html' --Content 'PGh0bWw+aGVsbG8gcGFnZTwvaHRtbD4=' --Id 50000001 --Name example
